about: Experience survival horror like never before in this bundle containing the definitive versions of Resident Evil 7 biohazard and Resident Evil Village.
With detailed graphics, intense first-person action and masterful storytelling, the terror has never felt more real in this heart-pounding narrative of family tragedy.

This pack includes the following content: • Resident Evil 7 biohazard Gold Edition • Not A Hero • Resident Evil Village Gold Edition • Resident Evil Village • Winters' Expansion additional content • Trauma Pack • Resident Evil…
Please be aware that Chinese, Korean and Thai are not included in Resident Evil Village.
